name: taskcut
description: Compaction at the end of a sub-task, not when the window fills, for Claude Code

plugins.name: taskcut
plugins.description: Compacts at the end of a sub-task instead of when the context window fills. Once the context is past a floor, a small model judges at the end of each turn whether the work asked for is finished, from the same inputs auto mode's permission classifier reads; if it is, taskcut runs Claude Code's own compaction. Below the floor it does nothing and costs nothing.
